name: ENKI Topic Relation Vocabulary Pack
description: The lattice between topics. While edgevocab governs how entities relate (officer_of, communicated_with), topicvocab governs how TOPICS relate to each other (broader_than, narrower_than, peer_of, explains, contradicts, follows, references, same_as). These are EPISTEMIC relations — they describe the structure of knowledge, not the structure of the world. Topics also carry temporal anchoring (temporal_span) and a concept/instance distinction borrowed from entityvocab. Forward-compat: new relation types extend the relation set; existing types are immutable; relation inverses are auto-defined.

metadata.author: ENKI System
forward_compat_rules: Relation types in v0.1.0 are permanent. v0.2.0+ can ADD relation types but cannot remove or rename.
Each relation has an `inverse` field — adding a new relation requires defining its inverse.
Temporal anchoring fields (temporal_span, temporal_anchor) are part of the topics table, governed by valuevocab's time chain.
concept/instance distinction is single-tier (a topic is either a concept or an instance) — adding more kinds requires a major version bump.
